reason: Separate cold display readiness from execution readiness and bound source-validated history/metrics maintenance without retaining a complete Session.
compatibility: RPC shapes, pagination cursors, existing journal/catalogue/checkpoint formats and execution recovery validation remain unchanged. Optional Store methods fall back for other backends. Only an identical validated catalogue source may repair an index or metric snapshot; scans never mint a runtime recovery stamp. Parsed index caching is entry/byte bounded and source/sidecar invalidated. Cache publication is best effort, including read-only filesystems. Native, persistence and Windows checks remain required.
